title: Shared cache and clone for the sync engine

keeps.check: Make a scratch consumer repository with a main branch, a dprint.jsonc and a valid .config/bootstrap.toml with environments = ["dev"]. Set XDG_CACHE_HOME to a scratch folder for every step, so the real ~/.cache is not touched. Sync the consumer once from the current main of bootstrap, so it has the old stub and the old setup/configs/sync. Make a local clone of the run's branch in which that branch is checked out as main. Set REPO_SYNC_URL and SYNC_ENGINE_URL to that local clone and REPO_SYNC_NO_AUTOUPDATE=1, then run mise run setup:configs in the consumer two times. When mise trust or PATH blocks the scratch run, use the method of gap G4 of docs/plans/2026-10-31-repo-sync-check (MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS, symlinks of pre-commit, gomplate and dprint in a scratch bin folder, a copied dprint.jsonc).
keeps.pass: The first run exits 0. After it, .config/mise/tasks/setup/configs/_default has the _se_ clone functions and the URL https://github.com/virajp/bootstrap.git as its default, and .config/mise/tasks/setup/configs/sync sources ${SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE}/sync-engine/repo-sync. The second run exits 0, writes its clone to <scratch>/sync-engine/repo/, and after it <scratch>/bootstrap/ and <scratch>/bootstrap.lock do not exist.

after_landing.notes: Archives the plan folder only when its gaps list has no open entry; with an open gap, skip this step and leave the folder live.

release_levels.reason: A new cache folder, the HTTPS clone URL and the removal of the old cache folders are new behavior; consumers change nothing.

units.title: The clone library and the repo-sync tasks
Move the repo-sync library to sync-engine and add the forwarding file
Tests for the new cache and the moved library
units.waits: Its cases run the output of U1 (sync-engine/clone, the stub template, the sync task, the gate) and of U2 (sync-engine/repo-sync, the forwarding file).

shared_files.why: every human-facing doc; the earlier units report DOCS FALSIFIED lines and never edit a doc

decisions.decision: Does the plan need a review unit?
decisions.ruling: Yes. U1 and U2 change bash code that each consumer runs, and U3 changes the test task. The plan lands runnable code, so one review unit in wave 3 covers U1, U2 and U3.
decisions.rejected: No review unit (the wave review alone does not run /security-review).

decisions.decision: Do the 16 plans of the macos-setup merge run in parallel?
decisions.ruling: No. The 16 plans form one linear chain through requires, because most of them edit sync-engine/repo-sync or sync-engine/setup-sync, and parallel plans conflict there. This plan is the first of the chain.

decisions.decision: Where do the tests of this plan go?
decisions.ruling: This plan extends test:repo-sync with cases for its new rules. A current case changes only where a ruling changes its expected result.

decisions.decision: Does the run sync bootstrap and its consumers?
decisions.ruling: No. mise run setup:configs in bootstrap and in each consumer stays a hand step (Out of scope), as in earlier plans.
decisions.rejected: A sync in an after-landing step.

decisions.ruling: It becomes the forwarding file and stays until the parked cleanup plan, because the old consumer stubs and the old setup/configs/sync tasks source it.
decisions.rejected: Remove it in the layout plan.

decisions.decision: How does the stub get the clone code before the clone exists?
decisions.ruling: The stub template embeds sync-engine/clone at render time with the gomplate function file.Read. The repo front-end adds the absolute path of the sync-engine/ folder of its clone copy to the template context as .sync_engine. One source, no copy in tools/.
decisions.rejected: A copy of the clone code in each stub (it drifts); a shipped _scripts/sync-clone (two tools ship one file).

decisions.decision: Which REPO_SYNC_* variables change their name?
decisions.ruling: REPO_SYNC_CLONE becomes SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE and REPO_SYNC_URL becomes SYNC_ENGINE_URL. REPO_SYNC_VALUES and REPO_SYNC_NO_AUTOUPDATE stay, because they are variables of the repo front-end. The internal gomplate variables of the library (REPO_SYNC_TOOLS, REPO_SYNC_ENVS and the others) stay.

decisions.decision: Does repo_sync still clone by itself?
decisions.ruling: No. The self-clone path goes. repo_sync without SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE and without --check returns 2 with a message that names mise run setup:configs.
decisions.rejected: Keep a clone in the library.

decisions.decision: What names does the clone library use?
decisions.ruling: Each function of sync-engine/clone starts with _se_ and each global variable with _SE_. The later shared libraries of sync-engine/ use the same prefix. The library defines only functions; _se_clone_init sets the paths from the environment when the caller calls it.
decisions.rejected: The _rs_ prefix (the library is not repo-only); public names without a prefix.

decisions.decision: How does the clone library print its messages?
decisions.ruling: Through _se_say <info|error> <text>. When the caller defined print_info and print_error (the helpers of the repo side), _se_say uses them. Else it prints 'sync-engine: <text>' on stderr. The Mac entry task of a later plan has no helpers.
decisions.rejected: Always the helpers (the Mac side has none); always plain stderr (the repo task output loses its style).

decisions.decision: Which clone variables does the new stub give the child task?
decisions.ruling: Both SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE and REPO_SYNC_CLONE, set to the same copy, for the root and for each member, until the parked cleanup plan. A member that has not synced yet has the old setup/configs/sync, which reads only REPO_SYNC_CLONE and then sources the forwarding file.
decisions.rejected: Only SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE (an old member task then runs its local library, which clones by itself over SSH).

decisions.decision: How does a run remove the old cache folders without a race with an old stub?
decisions.ruling: Each run, a dry run too, calls _se_legacy_cleanup while it holds the new lock. For ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bootstrap it first takes the old lock bootstrap.lock (mkdir, with the stale-lock rule of today for a dead holder); when a live pid holds it, the run skips the removal and says nothing. With the old lock taken, it removes bootstrap/ and then bootstrap.lock. Once the run holds the old lock, it releases it on success, on failure and on EXIT: _se_clone_cleanup, which the trap of the caller calls, releases it too. This plan does not touch ~/.cache/macos-setup/: the old Mac task can still run until plan 10, and the Mac entry task of plan 10 moves generated.txt to macos-generated.tsv and removes that folder.
decisions.rejected: A removal without the old lock (an old stub that holds it loses its clone during its copy); no removal in a dry run (the old folders stay until a real run).

decisions.decision: Does the gate code:lint:repo-sync take the lock of the cache?
decisions.ruling: No. The gate only reads <cache>/repo/sync-engine/repo-sync. A fetch at the same time is rare, and the next commit runs the gate again.
decisions.rejected: Take the lock (a commit then waits for a sync).

decisions.decision: Do the files of sync-engine/ carry the bootstrap header?
decisions.ruling: No. The sync never copies a file of sync-engine/ into a consumer, so the header rule of tools/ does not apply. Each file starts with the bash shebang, so shell_files_in_scope lints it, and a short comment that names its use.
decisions.rejected: The bootstrap header (it says the file is synced, which is not true).

decisions.decision: What does the forwarding file do when neither SYNC_ENGINE_CLONE nor REPO_SYNC_CLONE is set?
decisions.ruling: It prints 'repo-sync: no clone - run mise run setup:configs' on stderr and returns 2. It never clones and never reads the cache.
decisions.rejected: A fallback to the cache clone.

decisions.decision: How does the docs unit make sure that the docs are correct, and which number does the migrate item get?
decisions.ruling: The method of the repo-sync-check plan: the explicit list of passages in 05-docs.md, then vwf:docs-sync over the full branch delta, then grep checks. The new docs/sync/migrate.md item gets the next free number after the highest item (M27 when no other plan added one first).
decisions.rejected: vwf:docs-sync only; a fixed number that another plan can also take.

decisions.decision: Who sets the traps of the stub?
decisions.ruling: The caller. sync-engine/clone defines _se_clone_cleanup (it releases a held new lock and a held old lock, and removes the copy) and sets no trap. The stub sets trap _se_clone_cleanup EXIT, trap 'exit 130' INT and trap 'exit 143' TERM, as the stub does today.
decisions.rejected: The library sets the traps when it is sourced (a caller with its own cleanup loses it).

decisions.decision: Which mode does a file of sync-engine/ get?
decisions.ruling: Mode 755 for every file of sync-engine/ that has a shebang, clone included, because the check-shebang-scripts-are-executable hook refuses a file with a shebang and no execute bit.
decisions.rejected: Mode 644 for a library that a caller only sources.

decisions.decision: Who corrects the first-line comment of tools/repo-sync/tools.toml?
decisions.ruling: U2. It owns tools/repo-sync/tools.toml and changes its first comment line: the tool ships the setup:configs tasks, the gate and the forwarding file, not the sync function, which is in sync-engine/repo-sync.
decisions.rejected: Leave the comment (it is false after the move).
